title: Why LoRA works: low-rank approximation with SVD
setup:
import numpy as _np
_rng = _np.random.default_rng(7)
W = _rng.normal(size=(64, 4)) @ _rng.normal(size=(4, 64)) + 0.01 * _rng.normal(size=(64, 64))
def _ref_err(W, r):
    U, S, Vt = _np.linalg.svd(W)
    A = (U[:, :r] * S[:r]) @ Vt[:r]
    return _np.linalg.norm(W - A) / _np.linalg.norm(W)
_ref_best = next(r for r in range(1, 65) if _ref_err(W, r) < 0.05)
checks: The error falls as the rank grows
best_r is the smallest rank within 5 percent
LoRA with r=8 on a 4096 x 4096 layer saves 16,711,680 parameters
